title: File:1 Wild Turkey.jpg
author: John James Audubon
used_as: Turkey: cut out of plate 1 of The Birds of America (1827-38) as separate pieces (head and neck, lower beak, wattle, body, wing with its far edge cut into feather fingers) and hinged; seen as the pale reflection on the inside of the glass from his seat, and, filled flat black with the eye punched through, as the shadow-theatre shape in the tin's round window and as the huge shadow thrown on the culvert wall

title: File:Denton Brook Trout 1896.png
author: Sherman Foote Denton
used_as: the trout: the river-side audience is this one 1896 plate cut out of its page, flexed along the body and turned; the spotted fish behind the bars on Turkey's side is black card cut to this plate's outline, its jaw and tail on pins and its spots punched through as holes
